dedupe_keys.name: nfds national fire data system korea fire statistics by region fire station and ignition place trends and yearbook

description: The National Fire Data System (NFDS, 국가화재정보시스템) of the National Fire Agency of Korea is the statistics service of the national fire database, which aggregates information on fires in Korea. Its fire statistics service gives the number of fires, deaths, injuries, total casualties, property damage and damage per fire, filterable by period, region (city, county and district), responsible fire station and place or point of ignition, with a statistics overview and a report view. The site also offers fire trend analysis, thematic statistics, a status dashboard, the annual fire statistics yearbook (2025 edition listed) in its document service, and a finder for fire stations. Coverage is national; resolution runs down to municipality and fire station. Format and access: interactive web statistics with reports, and yearbook documents; no bulk download or API was checked. Licence: not stated. Free. Caveats: the interface is in Korean, the yearbook page reset the connection from the cloud, and the statistics page text was last revised in 2021. Simulation uses: fire incidence and loss rates by area and occupancy for fire service planning, emergency response and building fire risk models. Related records: comparable to the CTIF World Fire Statistics and the England fire incident level datasets.
